findings.title: No automated negative test for the ODN-17 replay-gate drift rejection (#599-r2 mask risk)
findings.evidence: ci.yml runs only `odin run harness -- run` (happy path); no core unit test exercises catalog/logic_hz drift rejection. Gate verified working manually (logic_hz 20->21 -> FAIL; catalog drift -> 'defined rejection').
findings.detail: A regression weakening the drift checks would pass CI -> the gate silently becomes a mask on the spine's load-bearing invariant.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a CI-exercised negative test asserting drift -> rejection.
